ei.title: Practice 01 — Emmi Pikler의 평화로운 규칙 교육
ei.subject: 올림포스독해의기본2

fullPassage: In her book written for parents, Emmi Pikler illustrates with an instructive example how to draw children's attention to rules in a peaceful manner. First, she suggests creating a safe play area for the children, suitable for their abilities and where nothing needs to be prohibited. Then when children are moving around on all fours, they may leave this safe area in their mother's company to discover their environment. Then the mother can draw their children's attention to the rules and prohibitions. The nearby books look intriguing, and they are happy to hang on to the tablecloth too. But then the mother repeats, "Don't do this!" If the children find this difficult to accept, put them back into their secure area where everything is allowed. However, the children should not feel this as a kind of punishment but should feel that their mother trusts them. "You are too young for these rules, but with time, this will change." These "walks" can be repeated from time to time. This way, Pikler says, the world gradually unfolds before the children instead of shrinking (which is what happens when we ban something that they used to be allowed to do beforehand and that we may even have found amusing). The children's world unfolds; and at the same time, they can understand more and more of these limitations and accept what the adult — gently but expressly — expects from them.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ which → where: 뒤 절(nothing needs to be prohibited)이 완전한 문장이므로 장소·상황을 받는 관계부사 where가 필요.
det.analysis:
❌ ① illustrates: 'Emmi Pikler illustrates' — 단수주어 + illustrates. 정상
❌ ② suggests: 'she suggests creating' — 단수주어 she + suggests. 정상
✅ ③ which(오류): 'their abilities and which nothing needs to be prohibited' — 뒤 절 'nothing needs to be prohibited'는 주어+동사가 다 갖춰진 완전한 절. 빠진 성분이 없으므로 관계대명사 which가 아니라 관계부사 where가 맞음 ← 정답
❌ ④ allowed: 'where everything is allowed' — 수동태(모든 것이 허용되는). 정상
det.tip: 관계대명사(which)는 뒤 절에 빠진 성분이 있을 때, 관계부사(where)는 뒤 절이 완전할 때. a safe play area ... where nothing needs to be prohibited(O).

det.tip: 3인칭 단수 주어 + 현재형 동사에는 -s. their mother(단수) trusts(O).

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ④ shrink → shrinking: 전치사 instead of 뒤에는 동명사(V-ing)가 와야 함.

det.tip: 전치사(instead of) + 동명사(V-ing). instead of shrinking(O) / instead of shrink(X).

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ④ which → what: 'is' 뒤에 선행사 없이 'happens'의 주어 역할을 하는 명사절이 필요하므로 선행사를 포함하는 관계대명사 what.
det.analysis:
❌ ① illustrates: 'Emmi Pikler illustrates' — 단수주어 + illustrates. 정상
❌ ② suggests: 'she suggests creating' — 정상
❌ ③ allowed: 'they used to be allowed to do' — 수동태. 정상
✅ ④ which(오류): '(which is which happens when we ban ...)' — 'is' 뒤에는 선행사 없이 그 자체로 '~하는 것'을 뜻하는 명사절이 필요. 선행사를 포함한 관계대명사 what이 맞음. which는 앞에 선행사가 있어야 하므로 오류 ← 정답
det.tip: what = the thing that(선행사 포함 관계대명사). 'this is what happens'=이것이 일어나는 일이다. 선행사 없이 명사절을 이끌 땐 what.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ② unsuitable → suitable: 놀이 공간은 아이들의 능력에 '적합한(suitable)' 것이어야 한다. unsuitable(부적합한)은 반대.
det.analysis:
❌ ① peaceful(평화로운): 평화로운 방식으로 — 적절
✅ ② unsuitable(부적합한) → suitable(적합한): 'a safe play area ... suitable for their abilities' — 아이의 능력에 '맞는' 공간. unsuitable은 정반대 ← 정답
❌ ③ discover(발견하다): 환경을 발견/탐색 — 적절
❌ ④ limitations(한계): 이 한계들을 이해 — 적절
det.tip: suitable for ~=~에 적합한. 안전 공간은 아이 능력에 맞아야 함. unsuitable은 반대.

However, the children should not feel this as a kind of ③<u>pleasure</u> but should feel that their mother trusts them. "You are too young for these rules, but with time, this will change." These "walks" can be repeated from time to time. This way, Pikler says, the world gradually unfolds before the children instead of shrinking (which is what happens when we ban something that they used to be allowed to do beforehand and that we may even have found ④<u>amusing</u>). The children's world unfolds; and at the same time, they can understand more and more of these limitations and accept what the adult — gently but expressly — expects from them.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ③ pleasure → punishment: 아이는 되돌려 보내지는 것을 '벌(punishment)'로 느껴서는 안 된다. pleasure(즐거움)는 문맥상 부적절.
det.analysis:
❌ ① instructive(교육적인): 교육적인 예시 — 적절
❌ ② repeats(반복하다): 엄마가 '하지 마'를 반복 — 적절
✅ ③ pleasure(즐거움) → punishment(벌): 'should not feel this as a kind of punishment' — 아이가 이를 '벌'로 느끼지 않게 하는 것이 요지. pleasure는 대비 구도에 맞지 않음 ← 정답
❌ ④ amusing(재미있는): 우리가 재미있다고 여겼을 수도 있는 — 적절
det.tip: a kind of punishment=일종의 벌. 되돌려 보내는 것을 벌이 아닌 신뢰로 느끼게 해야 함.

questions.passage: In her book written for parents, Emmi Pikler illustrates with an instructive example how to draw children's attention to rules in a peaceful manner. Then when children are moving around on all fours, they may leave this safe area in their mother's company to discover their environment. Then the mother can draw their children's attention to the rules and prohibitions. The nearby books look intriguing, and they are happy to hang on to the tablecloth too. But then the mother repeats, "Don't do this!" If the children find this difficult to accept, put them back into their secure area where everything is allowed. However, the children should not feel this as a kind of punishment but should feel that their mother trusts them. "You are too young for these rules, but with time, this will change." These "walks" can be repeated from time to time. This way, Pikler says, the world gradually unfolds before the children instead of shrinking (which is what happens when we ban something that they used to be allowed to do beforehand and that we may even have found amusing). questions.stem:

[조건] (1) allowed, area, back, everything, into, is, put, secure, their, them, where를 모두 사용할 것
(2) 정확히 11단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: put them back(그들을 되돌려 놓아라) into their secure area(그들의 안전한 구역으로) where everything is allowed(모든 것이 허용되는)
det.analysis:
구문 분석: put(명령문 동사원형) + them(목적어) + back + into their secure area(전치사구) + where everything is allowed(관계부사절). 선행사 area가 상황·장소를 뜻하고 뒤 절(everything is allowed)이 완전하므로 관계부사 where.

단어 순서: put → them → back → into → their → secure → area → where → everything → is → allowed (11단어).
det.tip: put A back into B = A를 B로 되돌려 놓다. 관계부사 where + 완전한 절(everything is allowed).
